system.description:
Thrown; set its radius anywhere from 6m to 80m. Living creatures in the area lose their combat action and roll a D10: on an odd number they also lose their move action and take that much damage. Anything more complex than staggering away needs a Tactics check (10). Afterwards they add no Skill bonuses to checks or attacks until 24 hours' rest or a Medicine check (13). No effect on Drones, Robots or pressurised vehicles. Runs an hour at 6m, two minutes at 80m; can't be switched off. Alien artefact: making it usable by a human takes a Repair check (12, or 8 with 2,000cr and a week). Powered by an Alien Power Cell.

Exploration Supplement
